gen-fs-red-hat-display-fs-asap: Asap keeps its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals and its c an open arc, while Red Hat Display draws marker-like lines. Paragraphs in it should move along smoothly.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-fs-epilogue: Approachable is the first word for Epilogue's curvy, unclamped letters, set beneath Red Hat Display's marker-like line with daylight in every curve. And the real strength here is how the wire-thin body softens a bold heading.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-fs-nunito: Approachable from the first word, with Nunito's big round bowls under a heading drawn as if by a round-tipped pen. Red Hat Display carries the bold contemporary voice, and a long page in Nunito would feel soft and unhurried, its terminals finishing clear of the stem.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-fs-public-sans: Sturdy and modern, with a marker-like heading line over a hefty lowercase. Red Hat Display is best at making a bold, contemporary statement; Public Sans is best at broad, open counters that keep text trustworthy and easy going.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-fs-quicksand: Quicksand has tall bowls like blown glass bulbs and bars that never change thickness. Red Hat Display sits above it with a bolder marker-like line, so a modest size step between them is plenty.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-general-sans: Red Hat Display draws a bold, marker-like line with daylight inside each curve, giving headings a contemporary punch. And General Sans follows with a tall x-height that fills the line, its steady pen pressure smoothing every bend of the sans-serif text.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-akatab: Akatab has round letters that look cupped rather than clenched, a gentle sans-serif body. Red Hat Display does bold and contemporary best, with a bent-paperclip line; Akatab does approachable, low-key text best.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-albert-sans: Crisp, contemporary and a bit bold up top. Albert Sans keeps its apertures open at tiny sizes beneath Red Hat Display's marker-like line, so the two feel like a confident voice and a quiet one sharing a table.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-alef: Red Hat Display sets a bold, contemporary tone, its marker-like strokes never mixing heavy and light inside a word. But Alef's open-ended curves keep the modern, clean plain sans text easy, and that pairing of confidence and openness is the best thing here.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-alegreya-sans-: Contemporary in both directions, with Red Hat Display skimming along at a constant stroke weight over a bold, marker-like line. Alegreya Sans SC opens a welcoming gap in the c, so a long page of this sans would feel inviting.
